senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בר, contr. of באר, בור) [to clear, clean; to place outside, whence]

units: <cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:17">Deut. XXII, 17</cite>) <he>ובוֹרְרִין את הדבר וכ׳</he> and they make the fact as clear (bright) as a new garment.—Part. pass. <cite ref="B01207"><he>בָּרוּר</he></cite> q. v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:6">Maasr. II, 6</cite> <he>שאָבוֹר לי</he> which I may select for me.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בּוֹרֵר ואוכל</he> he has a right to pick out and eat (one after the other).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:1">Kil. II, 1</cite> <he>יָבוֹר</he> he must take it out entirely.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הבּוֹרֵר</he> he who sifts (a labor forbidden on the Sabbath). Y. ib. VII, 10ᵃ, a. fr. <he>משום בורר</he> (is guilty) because it comes under the class of sifting. Bab. ib. 74ᵃ <he>בורר ואוכל וכ׳</he> he may take out singly and eat, take out singly and put it down (rejecting it) <he>ולא יִבְרוֹר</he> but he must not assort (v. discussion ibid.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:9">Gitt. V, 9</cite> <he>לא תָבוֹר</he> she must not help her to sift the grain.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 45a:8">Snh. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּרוֹר לו וכ׳</he> choose for the convict the most gentle method of execution; <cite ref="Sotah 8b:2">Sot. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:1">Snh. III, 1</cite> <he>זה בורר וכ׳</he> each party chooses one judge, and the two judges <he>בּוֹרְרִין וכ׳</he> elect a third.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 23b:11">Snh. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>צריך לבָרֵר</he> the claimant must offer clear evidence.

<cite ref="Keritot 24a:31">Kerith. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>לב׳ עוון</he> to ascertain whether or not the woman was guilty; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01062"><he>בָּעַר</he></cite>. Y. Kidd. III, 63ᵈ, v. <cite ref="O00718"><he>סִימְפּוֹן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to sift, select. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ top דש זרה ובי׳ he threshed, winnowed and sifted. Y. Ned. I, beg. 51ᵃ לשונות שביררו להן וכ׳ the terms (for oaths, vows &c.) which the Mishnahs have selected (as substitutes for the real expressions of oaths &c.); Bab.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 10b:4">Ned. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>שבדו</he>, v. <cite ref="B00101"><he>בָּדָא</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:12">Esth. R. to I, 22</cite> [read:] <he>בירר להם בלשון … רומי מלשון יוני</he> interpreted for them (the Bible) in Latin &c., v. <cite ref="B00101"><he>בָּדָא</he></cite>. The passage is defective; cmp. Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ top.] [Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ <he>בחרו להם ביררו הברזל וכ׳</he>, read <cite ref="B01251"><he>בְּרִיּוּת</he></cite>, they selected (as similes for the Law) the soundness of the iron and the fixedness of the tree; cmp.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:11">Koh. R. to XII, 11</cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be cleared up, to be decided (between two alternatives); v. בְּרֵירָה.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 4a:8">Bets. 4ᵃ</cite> (a hen is bought either for consumption or for breeding) <he>נשחטה הובְרָרָה וכ׳</he> by its being killed, it appears that it was originally intended for slaughtering; <cite ref="Chullin 14a:2">Ḥull. 14ᵃ</cite>

senses.gloss: to be selected. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ. 4 נִבְרְרוּ צדיקים they were righteous at the time they were selected.
to desire clearness, to seek evidence, search for truth.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11:5">Lev. R. s. 11</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 22:26">II Sam. XXII, 26</cite> sq.) <he>בשעה שנ׳ על עסקיו הק״בה בירר לו וכ׳</he> when he desired to be enlightened about his affairs (asking, ‘Whereby shall I know, <cite ref="Genesis 15:8">Gen. XV, 8</cite>), the Lord enlightened him &c. (ib. 13).
<cite ref="Genesis 15:8">Ib.</cite> <he>בשעה שנ׳ וכ׳</he> (with ref. to Moses); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:20">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 26</cite> sq.

senses.gloss: to be confirmed, established. Tanḥ. T’tsavveh 9, end [read:] נִתְבָּרְרָה כהונה בידם through them the priesthood became established. Pesik. Dibré p. 115ᵇ [read as:] Yalk. Jer. 258 לא נ׳ … עד שעמד וכ׳ their prophecies were not fulfilled until Jer. arose.
